evidence_strength: Stronger evidence for direct early-infant protection than for indirect adult-transmission effects.

evidence_strength: More implementation dependent than pregnancy Tdap; sensitive to adult-boosting and contact assumptions.
decision_role: Mechanistic exposure-reduction bundle with multiple components.
scenario_comparison_interpretation: The package combined direct passive protection, close-contact adult protection, reproductive-age adult boosting, and contact reduction; median component reductions were 12% for pregnancy Tdap alone, 34% for reproductive-age adult boosting, and 3% for contact reduction alone.

scenario_comparison_interpretation: Targeted outbreak/contact modifier for high-risk settings.

scenario_comparison_interpretation: Can reduce absolute resistant infections under specified assumptions; local programme effect depends on testing and implementation reach.

evidence_strength: Evidence is stronger for disease protection than for separate transmission-blocking components.
scenario_comparison_interpretation: Strategy comparisons should distinguish symptom prevention from infection, infectiousness, and duration effects.
